author: Shri Raghavendra Swami
commentary: तत्रासने उपविश्य ।  तदाह सूत्रे 'ॐ आसीनः संभवात् ॐ' (४.१.७) इति ।  यतचित्तेन्द्रियक्रियः सन् एकात्रं मनः कृत्वा आत्मनो मनसो विशुद्धये सर्वमलदाहाय स्वस्य संसारमलनिवृत्तये वा योगं ध्यानयोगं युञ्ज्यात् कुर्यादिति विध्यनुवादेन प्रकारोक्तिरियम् ॥ ६.१२॥
translation:
On such a seat having sat down and restrained the functions of the mind and other organs and devoted the mind to the One Thing, one should practise Yoga for the purification of the mind (or the 'self).
V. For..... or the self: for cleansing the mud of all passions so as to make it fit for intense devotion or for cleansing the self of all the evils of Samsâra. Practise Yoga: perform meditation. This verse in repeating the same injunctions describes the course to be followed. (12)
